projects.name: SURGE
projects.outcome: Turn captured gameplay into replay-backed investigation reports.

steps.label: Play
heading: SURGE STARTS
WITH PLAY.
steps.copy: Survive is a dodging game inside Surge. This replay shows movement from a controlled-speed trial.
facts: 60-second practice round · seed 1337.
Follow the player's path through the arena.

visual.caption: Recorded in Surge
visual.alt: Surge round setup with Controlled speed violation selected and seed 1337

steps.label: Record
heading: SURGE RECORDS
THE SESSION.
steps.copy: Watch Surge receive movement records as the saved trial's data passes through its recorder.
facts: Track game time and received records.
Check for gaps or parse errors.

visual.caption: Recorded in Surge
visual.alt: Surge's Recording view with game time and recording diagnostics

steps.label: Review
heading: SURGE REPLAYS
THE FINDING.
steps.copy: At 20.006 seconds, Surge flags a walking interval. The replay links it to records 689–692.
facts: Surge measured 20.00 cm.
The allowance was 16.17 cm.

visual.caption: Recorded in Surge
visual.alt: Surge replay at 20.006 seconds with the observed distance, allowance, and source record range

steps.label: Explain
heading: SURGE CONNECTS
THE EVIDENCE.
steps.copy: The investigator cites the flagged interval as E1 and records how the measured distance supports the finding.
facts: Read the observation alongside E1.
Reopen the cited moment in replay.

visual.caption: Recorded in Surge
visual.alt: Surge's investigation editor with analyst narrative and attached source evidence

steps.label: Export
heading: SURGE BUILDS
THE REPORT.
steps.copy: Surge exports the saved draft and its cited evidence to a self-contained HTML report.
facts: Review draft revision 3.
The report includes the evidence appendix.

visual.caption: Recorded in Surge
visual.alt: Surge's report export interface showing report readiness and investigation export

projects.name: INSIGHT
projects.outcome: Follow two verified investigations from a question to the bytes behind the decision.

steps.label: Compare
heading: WHEN IS THE
COOLDOWN READY?
steps.copy: Two builds encode the same cooldown decision. Follow the branch in the encoded build to see what happens at the deadline.
facts: Case 1 · Insight only
Read-only comparison of two supplied builds.

steps.label: Decide
heading: TEST THE
BOUNDARY.
steps.copy: At eight seconds the conditional move leaves C3 in place. The equality test returns ready in both builds.
facts: Deadline · 8 seconds
The decision covers the finite inputs shown.

steps.label: Verify
heading: MATCH THE
CAPTURE.
steps.copy: Open the bundled Surge observation in Insight and verify its DLL fingerprint. Compare the captured range with the file at the same address.
facts: Case 2 · Surge → Insight → Surge
Uses a saved observation. No live collector is required.

steps.label: Report
heading: CITE THE
FINDING.
steps.copy: Attach the reviewed Insight finding in Surge and follow its citation in the exported offline report. The match establishes what was present at sample time.
facts: A fresh investigation assigns evidence ID E1.
The sample cannot establish execution history.

projects.name: STUDYSTEP
projects.outcome: Turn topics and source material into reviewed study sets, then build a routine with practice and focus.

steps.label: Find
heading: START A SET
IN STUDYSTEP.
steps.copy: StudyStep starts with what you want to learn. Search a topic or bring your own material.
facts: Preview an English Wikipedia overview.
Or import PDF, DOCX, TXT or Markdown.

visual.caption: Workflow demonstration · regular desktop v0.3.2
visual.screenshotAlt: StudyStep 0.3.2 regular desktop: What would you like to learn? with file upload and topic search choices

steps.label: Select
heading: STUDYSTEP KEEPS
THE SOURCE CLOSE.
steps.copy: Inspect the material and choose the passages that will inform your study set.
facts: Read the original overview or your notes.
Select sections before generation.

steps.label: Draft
heading: STUDYSTEP BUILDS
A STUDY DRAFT.
steps.copy: Optional local AI turns selected excerpts into a guide, flashcards, and practice questions.
facts: Use a downloaded Ollama model.
Keep the draft open for review.

steps.label: Check
heading: STUDYSTEP CHECKS
THE EVIDENCE.
steps.copy: Quotation and structure checks precede a separate model review of the generated material.
facts: Connect answers to cited passages.
Revise once when checks need repairs.

steps.label: Review
heading: YOU REVIEW.
STUDYSTEP SAVES.
steps.copy: Compare each card with its source, edit when needed, and approve the cards you want to keep.
facts: Keep & next reviews each card.
Save study set after approval.

steps.label: Practice
heading: PRACTICE WITH
STUDYSTEP.
steps.copy: Use flashcards, multiple-choice questions, and recall practice to revisit the material.
facts: Try an answer before revealing it.
Rate recall to schedule another review.

visual.caption: Workflow demonstration · regular desktop v0.3.2
visual.screenshotAlt: StudyStep 0.3.2 regular desktop flashcards, showing the reference answer and recall rating controls

steps.label: Return
heading: MAKE LEARNING
A ROUTINE.
steps.copy: Your set and progress stay on your computer. A focus timer, collection, and journal help you return.
facts: Back up or export your study set.
Collect a design for time spent studying.

visual.caption: Workflow demonstration · regular desktop v0.3.2
visual.screenshotAlt: StudyStep 0.3.2 Focus collection with Spark, Orbit, and Constellation designs
